test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. Only Q sits exactly between W and Z. G sits sixth to the right of W. Only three people sit to the right of G. Z sits at the extreme left end of the row.

If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of people seated?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) Only three people sit to the right of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18a943022a1667a4ac55febc2e749baae3cc31d21d720914bc6980b454c0392f.png] 

2) G sits sixth to the right of W. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e2ebd3d25bc518dfb2653a67866873dc8b7a0537e2531ffc1dcd9a93d75c003.png] 

3) Only Q sits exactly between W and Z.

4) Z sits at the extreme left end of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc09545324668cb09baf3d8da205f75a911ee78940e4a4c4295f44d7a7a25610.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, 12 people are sitting in a row.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
